title: OpenAI Just Became Broadcom's Newest Chip Customer. Here's Why That's a Massive Deal for 2026.
title_zh: OpenAI 刚刚成为 Broadcom 的最新芯片客户。这就是为什么这是 2026 年的一项大规模交易。
summary: Broadcom has added OpenAI to its growing list of design partners. That makes it a stock you should seriously consider for 2026.
summary_zh: Broadcom 已将 OpenAI 添加到其不断增长的设计合作伙伴名单中。这使得它成为你在 2026 年应该认真考虑的股票。

title: Hesai Group (HSAI) Is Down 18.6% After First Full-Year Profit And NVIDIA LiDAR Deal - What's Changed
title_zh: 禾赛集团 (HSAI) 首次实现全年盈利并与 NVIDIA LiDAR 达成交易后股价下跌 18.6% - 发生了什么变化
summary: Hesai Group recently reported its fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results, with full-year sales of CNY 3,027.57 million and net income of CNY 435.88 million, marking its first full-year GAAP profitability and a turnaround from the prior year’s net loss.
summary_zh: 禾赛集团近日公布了2025年第四季度及全年业绩，全年销售额30.2757亿元，净利润4.3588亿元，首次实现全年GAAP盈利，扭转了上年净亏损的局面。

title: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market Fades Amid Iran War Deal Hopes, Doubts
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：在伊朗战争协议的希望与怀疑中股市下跌
summary: The stock market slashed gains amid Iran war hopes and doubts. Space play Karman Holdings reported earnings late.
summary_zh: 在伊朗战争的希望和疑虑中，股市大幅下跌。太空游戏卡曼控股公司 (Karman Holdings) 晚间公布了财报。

title: Amazon Is Entering the Humanoid Robot Market. 3 Important Things to Know About the Fauna Robotics Acquisition.
title_zh: 亚马逊正在进军人形机器人市场。关于 Fauna Robotics 收购需要了解的 3 件重要事项。
summary: Amazon is gearing up to become a much bigger player in robotics.
summary_zh: 亚马逊正准备成为机器人领域更大的参与者。

title: KKR Strikes Deal for Nothing Bundt Cakes
title_zh: KKR 达成无偿交易 Bundt Cakes
summary: Private-equity giant  KKR  has struck a deal to acquire the U.S. bakery chain Nothing Bundt Cakes from Roark Capital for over $2 billion, including debt, according to people familiar with the matter. Nothing Bundt Cakes was started by two mothers in 1997.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，私募股权巨头 KKR 已达成协议，以超过 20 亿美元（含债务）从 Roark Capital 手中收购美国面包连锁店 Nothing Bundt Cakes。 Nothing Bundt Cakes 由两位母亲于 1997 年创立。
